source_visual_observations: Circle centered at M; two equal perpendicular center-to-chord distances; angle MTN labeled 28 degrees.
audit.independent_solution: Equal distances from the center give equal chords CA and TN. Each radius-to-chord base angle is equal, so angle CAM equals angle MTN = 28 degrees.
